aspectRatio.description:
Desired output aspect ratio, applied on a best-effort basis. When editing a previously generated image, reuse the exact `aspectRatio` enum value used to generate that image if that value is present in prior conversation or tool-call context, unless the user explicitly requests a different ratio. If the prior enum value is unavailable, omit this argument. For a new image without an explicit ratio, omit this argument. Do not retry solely if the returned image does not exactly match the requested ratio.
When provided, `aspectRatio` must be exactly one of the enum values listed below. Translate the user's request into the matching enum value; for example, for `1:1`, send `SQUARE_1_1`. Never send a raw ratio such as `1:1` or a descriptive word such as `square`. If the user provides both an explicit numeric ratio and conflicting descriptive wording, use the numeric ratio to choose the enum value.
- `SQUARE_1_1`: Use for "square" or "1:1".
- `LANDSCAPE_16_9`: Use for "landscape", "wide", "widescreen", or "16:9".
- `LANDSCAPE_5_4`: Use for an explicit "5:4".
- `LANDSCAPE_4_3`: Use for an explicit "4:3".
- `LANDSCAPE_3_2`: Use for an explicit "3:2".
- `LANDSCAPE_2_1`: Use for an explicit "2:1", "panoramic", or "ultra-wide".
- `PORTRAIT_9_16`: Use for "portrait", "tall", "vertical", or "9:16".
- `PORTRAIT_4_5`: Use for an explicit "4:5".
- `PORTRAIT_3_4`: Use for an explicit "3:4".
- `PORTRAIT_2_3`: Use for an explicit "2:3".
- `PORTRAIT_1_2`: Use for an explicit "1:2".

print.description: Print information for the design. Absent when printability was not determined.

design.description: The generated design. Only present when the job completed.

code.description: Why the job failed. 'moderation_blocked' means the brief or a reference was declined by content moderation - tell the user and do not retry the same input. 'feature_disabled' means design creation has been disabled by the user's admin - ask the user to contact their admin to enable it before trying again. 'quota_exceeded' means the user is out of AI credits. 'throttled' means too many requests - retry later. 'invalid_input' will not succeed on retry without changing the request.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, suitable to show the user.

failure.description: Why the job failed. Only present when status is 'failed'.

asset_id.description: ID of a PNG, JPEG, or WEBP image asset in the user's Canva account, as returned when the image was uploaded or listed. Not a URL, a local file path, or a design ID.

title.description: Title for the new design, e.g. 'Summer sale poster'. Use the user's wording when they gave one.

user_intent.description: Mandatory description of what the user is trying to accomplish with this tool call. This should always be provided by LLM clients. Please keep it concise (255 characters or less recommended).

job_id.description: Stable ID of the layer-separation job. Pass it to get-separate-image-layers-job on every poll.

status.description: Status of the newly queued job. 'pending' means the job was queued - this call never returns the finished design directly; poll get-separate-image-layers-job with the job_id and continuation_token for completion or failure. 'failed' means no job was queued and there is nothing to poll; the failure explains why.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token to pass on the first poll to get-separate-image-layers-job. Always use the most recent token from the last response.

wait_seconds.description: The number of seconds you MUST wait before calling get-separate-image-layers-job. Polling sooner returns the same answer and does not make the design arrive sooner.

instructions.description: Instructions on when to poll this job next, in words. They MUST be followed. Relay them to the user while they wait.

polling_policy.description: How and when to poll next.

code.description: Why no job was queued. 'quota_exceeded' means the user is out of AI credits - tell the user and do not retry. 'quota_cooldown' means their credit usage is in a temporary cooldown period - tell the user and do not retry until it has elapsed.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, suitable to show the user.

failure.description: Why no job was queued. Only present when status is 'failed', in which case there is no job_id or continuation_token to poll with.

job_id.description: Stable ID of the layer-separation job, returned when the separation request starts.

continuation_token.description: Exact continuation token returned by the most recent response for this layer-separation job.

user_intent.description: Mandatory description of what the user is trying to accomplish with this tool call. This should always be provided by LLM clients. Please keep it concise (255 characters or less recommended).

job_id.description: ID of the separation job. Stable across all responses.

status.description: Status of the job. While 'in_progress', poll again with the job_id and the continuation_token from this response. 'polled_too_early' means the wait window had not elapsed and nothing was checked. 'completed' carries the design; 'failed' carries the failure.

continuation_token.description: Opaque token to pass on the next poll. Always use the most recent token from the last response. Absent once the job is finished.

wait_seconds.description: The number of seconds you MUST wait before polling again. Polling sooner returns the same answer and does not make the design arrive sooner.

instructions.description: Instructions on when to poll this job next, in words. They MUST be followed. Relay them to the user while they wait.

polling_policy.description: How and when to poll next. Only present while the job is still running.

url.description: URL to view the design in Canva. Always share this link with the user.

edit_url.description: URL to open the design in the Canva editor.

design.description: The created design. Only present when the job completed.

code.description: Why the job failed. 'moderation_blocked' means the image was declined by content moderation - tell the user and do not retry the same image. 'quota_exceeded' means the user is out of AI credits. 'throttled' means too many requests - retry later. 'invalid_input' will not succeed on retry with the same image.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, suitable to show the user.

failure.description: Why the job failed. Only present when status is 'failed'.
